subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should Control UI show canonical provider ids only, or preserve configured aliases with canonical context, for Sessions/Usage display, filters, CSV, and aggregates?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but the choice affects user-visible provider identity, exported data, and aggregate grouping semantics.

options.title: Canonicalize derived UI only
options.body: Normalize derived display/filter/suggestion/CSV/aggregate values with the existing provider-id contract while preserving raw config/session storage and avoiding new aliases unless separately approved.

options.title: Show alias with canonical context
options.body: Display labels such as `zai (alias: bailian)` or tooltips where the raw alias matters, at the cost of a wider UI contract and more copy/tests.

options.title: Preserve raw aliases
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that Control UI reflects stored provider keys, accepting the inconsistency with internal routing/display helpers.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize derived UI only
recommendation.body: Normalize derived display/filter/suggestion/CSV/aggregate values with the existing provider-id contract while preserving raw config/session storage and avoiding new aliases unless separately approved.
